scope: Independent source/configuration delta review plus local compiler/schema/guard checks; not a rerun of the original Cloudflare audit or provider execution.

local_validation.scope: Official schema/route compilation and path boundary; no provider execution, rate-limit enforcement or application calls.

provider_smoke_plan.purpose: Positive canonical health, exact remote HTML/JavaScript hashes, and rejection of three critical function-entry aliases; independent of per-IP counters, not an enforcement test from a blocked IP.

limitations: Cloud normalization, static bytes and routing classifications still need provider observations.
404 alone does not prove no function execution.
No new blocked-IP rate-limit enforcement is claimed.
